title: Design Creativity Bench: Measuring creativity in LLM-Generated UI
abstract: arXiv:2610.11539v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As leading LLMs improve on capability evaluations, their limitations in producing creative outputs on design tasks remain insufficiently characterised. Our work introduces Design Creativity Bench, a benchmark that evaluates diversity and appropriateness in UI designs. It measures distinctiveness among models on the same prompt (originality), how much a model's designs change between two prompts for the same UI goal in different product domains (creative range), and the share of a brief's acceptance criteria each design meets (appropriateness). Originality is 0.592 for same-prompt design pairs from different models (95% CI [0.582, 0.602]), far below the 0.764 for same-prompt human-model pairs (95% CI [0.751, 0.778]). Creative range is 0.581 across models (95% CI [0.567, 0.597]), against 0.902 for human designs (95% CI [0.884, 0.919]). Appropriateness is above 90% for every model, and the best model reaches 99.2%, slightly above the 98.0

translated_title: 设计创造力基准：衡量大语言模型生成用户界面中的创造力
translated_abstract: 随着领先的大语言模型在能力评估中不断进步，它们在设计任务中产出创造性成果方面的局限性仍未得到充分刻画。我们的工作引入了设计创造力基准，这是一个评估用户界面设计中多样性与适宜性的基准。它测量三个方面：相同提示词下不同模型之间设计的独特性（原创性）、同一UI目标在不同产品领域的两个提示词之间模型设计的变化程度（创造力范围），以及每个设计满足任务书验收标准的比例（适宜性）。不同模型在同一提示词下生成的设计对的原创性为0.592（95% CI [0.582, 0.602]），远低于人类与模型在同一提示词下设计对的0.764（95% CI [0.751, 0.778]）。模型的创造力范围为0.581（95% CI [0.567, 0.597]），而人类设计的创造力范围为0.902（95% CI [0.884, 0.919]）。所有模型的适宜性均超过90%，最佳模型达到99.2%，略高于98.0……
tldr: 本文提出设计创造力基准，从原创性、创造力范围和适宜性三个维度评估大语言模型生成的UI设计，发现模型间同提示词设计的原创性远低于人机设计对，且模型的创造力范围（0.581）显著低于人类设计（0.902），表明大语言模型在设计创造力方面仍存在明显差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Design Creativity Bench, which evaluates LLM-generated UI designs across originality, creative range, and appropriateness, revealing that LLM designs show far lower originality across models and a much smaller creative range (0.581 vs. 0.902 for humans) compared to human designs, indicating a significant creativity gap in LLM design capabilities.
